name: Woodland Fern
finished_size: About 17 cm long and 7 cm wide

yarn.description: Mercerised cotton yarn for the fern frond

gauge: Gauge is not critical. Keep the chain spine relaxed so the frond lies flat and reaches the stated approximate length.

steps.label: Leaflets 1-6
steps.text: Rep 6 times: In the top loop of the next foundation ch, sl st, ch 3, sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, sl st in the same foundation ch.

steps.label: Leaflets 7-13
steps.text: Rep 7 times: In the top loop of the next foundation ch, sl st, ch 4, sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, sc in next ch, sl st in the same foundation ch.

steps.label: Leaflets 14-21
steps.text: Rep 8 times: In the top loop of the next foundation ch, sl st, ch 5, sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, dc in next ch, hdc in next ch, sl st in the same foundation ch.

steps.label: Leaflets 22-29
steps.text: Rep 8 times: In the top loop of the next foundation ch, sl st, ch 9, sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, dc in next ch, tr in each of the next 2 ch, dc in next ch, hdc in next ch, sc in next ch, sl st in the same foundation ch.

steps.label: Leaflets 30-36
steps.text: Rep 7 times: In the top loop of the next foundation ch, sl st, ch 5, sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, dc in next ch, hdc in next ch, sl st in the same foundation ch.

steps.label: Leaflets 37-43
steps.text: Rep 7 times: In the top loop of the next foundation ch, sl st, ch 4, sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, sc in next ch, sl st in the same foundation ch.

steps.label: Leaflets 44-50
steps.text: Rep 7 times: In the top loop of the next foundation ch, sl st, ch 3, sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, sl st in the same foundation ch.

steps.label: Second Side 1-7
steps.text: Working back towards the hook end in the unused back bumps of the foundation ch, rep 7 times: In the next unworked back bump, sl st, ch 3, sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, sl st in the same back bump.

steps.label: Second Side 8-14
steps.text: Rep 7 times: In the next unworked back bump, sl st, ch 4, sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, sc in next ch, sl st in the same back bump.

steps.label: Step 11
steps.text: Rep 7 times: In the next unworked back bump, sl st, ch 5, sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, dc in next ch, hdc in next ch, sl st in the same back bump.

steps.label: Step 12
steps.text: Rep 8 times: In the next unworked back bump, sl st, ch 9, sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, dc in next ch, tr in each of the next 2 ch, dc in next ch, hdc in next ch, sc in next ch, sl st in the same back bump.

steps.label: Step 13
steps.text: Rep 8 times: In the next unworked back bump, sl st, ch 5, sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, dc in next ch, hdc in next ch, sl st in the same back bump.

steps.label: Step 14
steps.text: Rep 7 times: In the next unworked back bump, sl st, ch 4, sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, sc in next ch, sl st in the same back bump.

steps.label: Step 15
steps.text: Rep 6 times: In the next unworked back bump, sl st, ch 3, sc in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, sl st in the same back bump.

finishing: Fasten off after the final leaflet, leaving a 10 cm tail.
Weave in both yarn tails along the central spine on the reverse side.
Lightly mist and pin the frond flat, arranging the leaflets evenly on both sides of the spine. Let it dry completely.
notes: The top loops are worked on the first pass along the foundation chain; the unused back bumps form the attachment points for the second side.
For a fuller fern, gently curve alternate leaflets in opposite directions while blocking.
